6.131 rsMultiStaticColumnsOrRows
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsMultiStaticColumnsOrRows is a critical error that will occur if a Matrix contains multiple instances of
either RowGrouping.StaticRows elements or ColumnGrouping.StaticColumns elements.
